title: Tests show cement-bonded particle board can reduce flame spread in rooftop PV systems
content:
Researchers in Denmark found that a 12 mm cement-bonded particle board can reduce self-sustained flame spread beneath rooftop PV arrays by limiting heat transfer to the underlying insulation. The findings highlight the role of complete PV system design in determining fire behavior.

content:
Carrier has launched the WeatherFlex 50FC, a reversible air-to-air rooftop heat pump for commercial and industrial buildings, offering heating capacities of 22 kW to 50 kW and using R-454C refrigerant. The system operates at outdoor temperatures from -18 C to 50 C and features variable-speed scroll compressors.

title: Segen, Zopa Bank launch UK residential solar financing
content:

Integrated into Segen’s digital proposal platform, the product allows homeowners to apply for financing during the sales process while reducing upfront hardware costs for installers.

title: AI-assisted method maps PV module losses from a single luminescence image
content:
An international research team has developed an AI-assisted method that quantifies PV module power losses from a single luminescence image. The approach achieved an overall error of around 0.5% in tests on 300 field-retrieved modules and was demonstrated using drone-based imaging at a 186 kW solar farm.

title: Vietnam pushes provinces to accelerate rooftop solar rollout
content:
The Vietnamese government has ordered provinces to accelerate rooftop solar support after most missed a national deadline, even as looser surplus-power rules have yet to produce a single recorded sale.

title: Sri Lanka replaces net metering with feed-in tariffs for rooftop solar
content:
Sri Lanka has discontinued net metering for new rooftop solar systems, requiring new installations to operate under its Net Plus feed-in tariff scheme with agreements capped at 12 years. The change comes as the country’s rooftop PV capacity reached 1.94 GW at the end of 2025, following rapid growth in installations and generation.
